entities.name: Nemata
entities.description: Magnigoth treefolk lord of Yavimaya, over three thousand feet tall, guardian of Rith's Grove.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: Primeval dragon imprisoned in Nemata, freed by Darigaaz.

entities.name: Numena
entities.description: Ancient beings who imprisoned the primeval dragons.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: Dragon who freed Rith first after Tevesh Szat told him of the Primevals.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Told Darigaaz the legend of the Primevals.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Forest of Dominaria where Nemata lives.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Place to which the magnigoths traveled to recapture Rith.

entities.name: Verdeloth the Ancient
entities.description: Magnigoth treefolk resembling the guardian that held Rith.

events.summary: Rith, imprisoned in Nemata by the Numena, is freed first by Darigaaz.
events.quote: The primeval dragon Rith was originally imprisoned inside Nemata in Yavimaya by the Numena

events.summary: Nemata and the magnigoths travel from Yavimaya to Urborg to recapture Rith; the lead treefolk swallows her.
events.quote: The lead treefolk ripped her out of the sky and swallowed her before returning to Yavimaya.

events.summary: Rith escapes during the Second Phyrexian Invasion and Nemata wakes his fellow treefolk to recapture her.
events.quote: Rith's sudden escape during the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria left Nemata furious

relations.note: Nemata held Rith captive inside him.
relations.quote: The primeval dragon Rith was originally imprisoned inside Nemata in Yavimaya by the Numena
